heard.text: {Recipient} just came home from the hospital.

expected.planIntro: You have a good start. Here's how to build on it.
whatWeHeard: Mom just came home from the hospital.
What worries you most: safety at home and your own exhaustion.

beforeAfter.before: Things are changing, and every day brings a new hard moment.
beforeAfter.after: You have calm ways to handle the hard moments, a steadier routine, and a care card anyone who helps can use.

modules.title: Talking with Mom
modules.reason: Everyone starts here. As things change, the way you talk with Mom makes every day easier.

modules.title: Safe home, calmer days
modules.reason: Because Mom just came home from the hospital, and safety at home comes first.

modules.title: Hard moments
modules.reason: Because you said some moments are getting harder.

modules.title: While she can still decide
modules.reason: Because some of Mom's key papers are missing.

modules.title: Caring for yourself
modules.reason: Because you said you're exhausted. Your health matters too.

modules.title: Doctors and your care team
modules.reason: Because a sitter helps, and a care card shows them what works with Mom.

modules.title: Getting more help
modules.reason: For when Mom needs more help than you can give alone.

modules.title: Later stages
modules.reason: Comfort, connection and the conversations families need, when the time comes.

loaderLines: Starting with how to talk with Mom…
Moving papers up, while Mom can take part…
Adding the hard moments you mentioned…
Setting the pace to fit your day…

pace.label: About 15 minutes a lesson, 5 lessons a week
